articles.summary: LOUISVILLE, Ky., Oct. 08, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Texas Roadhouse, Inc. (NasdaqGS: TXRH) announced today that it will release third quarter 2026 financial results on Thursday, November 5, 2026 after the market close. A conference call will follow at 5:00 PM ET and will be webcast live from the investor relations portion of the Company's website at investor.texasroadhouse.com . Listeners may also access the call by dialing (833) 461-5787 and using conference ID 696404886. A replay of the webcast will be available on the Company's Investor Relations website shortly after the conclusion of the call. About the Company Texas Roadhouse is a growing restaurant company operating predominantly in the casual dining segment that first opened in 1993 and today has grown to over 840 restaurants system-wide in 49 states, one U.S. territory, and ten foreign countries. For more information, please visit the Company’s Web site at www.texasroadhouse.com . Contacts: Investor Relations Michael
articles.title: Texas Roadhouse, Inc. to Announce Third Quarter Earnings on November 5, 2026
